items.title: Goldman pushes Fed rate hike to December after cooler inflation
items.summary: Investing.com -- Goldman Sachs has pushed back its forecast for the next Federal Reserve rate hike from October to December following a softer-than-expected August inflation reading, while warning that the tightening cycle may already be over.
